entries.topic: Counterforces: the opposition and the costs of its defeat (Nov 2026)

claims.text: AHC boycotted UNSCOP (letter of 10 July 1947), rights 'self-evident'; Arab League states testified at Sofar, Lebanon, 23 July 1947 (Riad al-Solh, Hamid Frangieh).
AHC outlawed after the Andrews assassination (26 Sept 1937); three members deported to the Seychelles; al-Husseini into exile; reconstituted by the Arab League Nov 1945.

Revolt toll by summer 1939: about 5,000 Arab, 415 Jewish, 100 British deaths; 20,000 British troops; the revolt's defeat 'an important reason for the Palestinian defeat in 1948'; 1939 White Paper: 75,000 immigrants over five years.
Faisal's condition: binding only if the Arabs obtained their independence; otherwise 'not be bound by a single word'.
Forrestal the most outspoken opponent of partition; JCS feared Soviet participation; 80,000-160,000 troops estimate, Feb 1948; trusteeship proposal 19 March 1948.
